privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create four specific records in the GardenWorld client of iDempiere. 1. Request Type: 'Design Consultation'. 2. Request Category: 'Plant Selection' (Description: 'Assistance with choosing plants for specific climates'). 3. Request Group: 'Design Team'. 4. Request Resolution: 'Proposal Accepted' (Description: 'Customer accepted the design proposal'). All records must be marked as 'Active'. These records are synthetic and do not exist in the default seed data.
